sentences.text: Shantungosaurus represents the largest known hadrosauroid taxon, reaching estimated lengths of 15 to 17 meters and weighing between 13 and 16 metric tons.
This massive creature possessed a toothless beak but utilized approximately 1,500 tiny teeth within its jaws to process food.
The genus was first described in 1973 based on more than five incomplete skeletons unearthed between 1964 and 1968.
Shantungosaurus was a heavy quadruped with massive legs designed to support its bulky body.
It could walk on its hind legs equipped with hooves, but also on all four legs since its hands ended in hooves as well.
Specimens originally classified as Zhuchengosaurus maximus in 2007 were later determined to be Shantungosaurus, with differences attributed to growth stages.
Shantungosaurus lived during the middle to late Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous.
